entities.summary: Arnold Heim was a Swiss geologist known for his pioneering research in petrogeology and his geological expeditions across Asia. He made significant contributions to the understanding of relationships between sedimentation and tectonics, and conducted extensive geological surveys in the Himalayas and Southeast Asia.
